summary: Create management bridge from selected GUI installer NIC. API impact: existing contract — existing local service discovery/preflight/deployment consumes br0; no Controller/agent wire changes.

guide.reason: Selected management NIC now creates bridge and host addressing lives on br0; document fresh-GUI versus old/minimal hosts.

api.reason: Existing local bridge discovery/preflight/deployment fields and authorization remain unchanged; installer writes native OS networking only.

state.reason: The management bridge is host-local network configuration created at install time and observed by the agent; it is not Controller state.
state.record: br0 in /etc/network/interfaces on the installed host, written by the installer; the agent reports the resulting NICs, bridge and addresses in inventory, and the Controller keeps no copy.

verification.method: Failing-before/passing-after generated configuration check, native isolated Debian networking and GUI review; actual results and limits in QA report.
